input.prompt: One naturally irregular high-altitude cloud mass seen from directly above, pale cool white and silver-blue, realistic soft vapor edges and subtle internal volume. Isolated on a transparent canvas with large clear margins and no cut-off feathering. Consistent soft upper-left illumination, photographic aerial realism, no sky gradient, sun, aircraft, ocean, ground, text or purple/gold tones. Small wispy foreground mass: a thin irregular vapor veil with translucent broken tendrils and readable natural density, not a uniform opacity sheet. Keep it entirely inside the canvas; position its coded entry from the lower left after compositing. Match the same aerial scale, cool-white/silver-blue vapor palette and upper-left lighting across the selected set. Render only one separate cloud mass, no multi-view or contact sheet. Atmosphere retains its natural scene palette; no painted surfaces are requested. All painted carbon or graphite surfaces use Pegasoft carbon #11151B as their shared base paint color. Graphite describes the material appearance; do not introduce a separate grey-blue paint variant. Preserve the separately approved blue, brushed silver/titanium, rubber and glass material roles. Natural highlights and shadows come from lighting, not different paint colors.

recipe.note: These are the submitted inputs, not resolved server defaults. For a variation, copy them and change only requested fields; reuse returned_seed when supported by the schema. Source URLs may expire.

display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
